cause_quote: The original reader used `for (const rawSegment of path.split("."))` and `rawSegment.split(/[[\]]/).filter(Boolean)`, splitting literal dots and brackets inside record keys.
user_saw: The setup agent reported “not set” for an existing configuration entry whose key contained a literal dot or bracket.
summary: The setup agent now uses the shared configuration path parser for reads, so quoted and escaped keys resolve correctly while sensitive values remain redacted.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and confirmed that it added the read operation and a tool that passed paths directly to the delimiter-splitting reader, so that tool could never resolve these keys. A later commit expanded command validation to accept quoted and escaped paths, exposing the same lookup failure through typed commands.
